task_fulfillment.rationale: The single supplied Word SOP substantially covers warehouse activities, training, verification and records. Material corrections remain: transport exceptions conflict with outside-EPA protection, task-required ESD gloves are omitted, and conductive foam/tray guidance is incomplete. Actual use of the requested standard is not demonstrated beyond citation and general-practice attribution. The five-page limit cannot be verified from text extraction; rendering remains a separate endpoint. No companion-file inconsistency or clearly unnecessary hold was established.
